$comment: The shop this build is for. Change these, run `npm run brand`, rebuild. Everything downstream - the Android app name and launcher icon, the web title, the PWA manifest, and the branding a fresh till starts with - reads from here, so the name lives in one place instead of six.
description: Offline-first point of sale, inventory and recipe costing.
$comment_icon: The home-screen icon. Square, 1024x1024 ideally. Kept separate from `logo` on purpose: a wide wordmark that reads beautifully on a receipt turns to mush in a 48-pixel circle, so the launcher usually wants a simpler mark. Point both at the same file if you want them identical.
$comment_zoom: How much of the launcher canvas the artwork fills, 0-1. Android crops adaptive icons to roughly the middle two thirds, so anything above ~0.66 risks losing its edges.
